result.instructions: Tools for FieldAware, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the jobs scheduled for next Monday with their state and assigned lead."; "Show the details, crew and tasks of job J2225."; "Create a job for the Plano customer on 25 November at 09:00, 90 minutes, and set its description.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FieldAware data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fieldaware_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fieldaware_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fieldaware_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fieldaware_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fieldaware_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Identify the FieldAware user that the API key belongs to (uuid, user URL, roles and email). Use it to check the key works. GET /auth/whoami.

tools.name: fieldaware_get_business
tools.title: Get business profile
tools.description: Read the company profile of the FieldAware account (name, address, contact details and settings). GET /business.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List field-service jobs scheduled in a time window (deferred and recurring jobs included), with state, schedule, location, crew and tasks. The window is required. GET /job/?start=&end=.

state.description: Filter by state, e.g. Scheduled, Active, Completed.

jobLead.description: Filter by the job lead's user uuid.

sortedBy.description: Sort field: scheduledOn, jobId, state, jobLead or location. Prefix with "-" to sort descending.

tools.name: fieldaware_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Read one job: its description, schedule, state, customer location, asset, crew, tasks, items and labor. GET /job/{uuid}.

job.description: The job uuid, as returned by a list or create tool.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (companies or accounts) with their name, customer id and discount. Filter by name, email, tax status or GL account. GET /customer/.

sortedBy.description: Sort field: customerId or name. Prefix with "-" to sort descending.

tools.name: fieldaware_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Read one customer by uuid, including its discount, billing details and custom fields. GET /customer/{uuid}.

customer.description: The record uuid, as returned by a list or get tool.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contact persons (first name, last name, email, phone) and the customer each belongs to. GET /contact/.

customer.description: Only contacts of this customer uuid.

sortedBy.description: Sort field: firstName, lastName, email, phone or customer. Prefix with "-" to sort descending.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List service locations (street address, locality, region, postcode, country) and whether each is a billing location. GET /location/.

locality.description: City or locality to match, e.g. Dublin.

region.description: Region or state to match, e.g. MA.

customer.description: Only locations of this customer uuid.

sortedBy.description: Sort field: name, streetName, locality, region, postcode, country, isBilling or type. Prefix with "-" to sort descending.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their number, created date, location and total amount. Optionally limit to a created-date range. GET /invoice/.

location.description: Only invoices for this location uuid.

start.description: Only invoices created on or after this date.

end.description: Only invoices created on or before this date.

sortedBy.description: Sort field: invoiceNumber, createdOn, location or totalAmount. Prefix with "-" to sort descending.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List catalogue items (parts and products) with name, part number and prices. GET /item/.

sortedBy.description: Sort field: name. Prefix with "-" to sort descending.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_tasks
tools.title: List task templates
tools.description: List the service task templates (name, price, tax and GL account) that jobs can use. GET /task/.

sortedBy.description: Sort field: name. Prefix with "-" to sort descending.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List customer assets (equipment to service) with name, serial number and manufacturer. GET /asset/.

tools.name: fieldaware_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List FieldAware users (field engineers, dispatchers, managers) with email, role and time zone. GET /user/.

archived.description: true lists archived users; false or omitted lists active users.

sortedBy.description: Sort field: email. Prefix with "-" to sort descending.

tools.name: fieldaware_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer with its first service location (the location is required). Returns the new customer's uuid. POST /customer/. Creates a real record in the account.

location.description: The customer's first service location. FieldAware validates the required fields.

tools.name: fieldaware_create_job
tools.title: Create job
tools.description: Create a job on a date and time, optionally with its location, contact, asset and job lead. Returns the new job (uuid and jobId). POST /job/. Creates a real record that field staff will see.

scheduledOn.description: When the job is scheduled, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-25T09:00:00Z.

location.description: An existing location, by its uuid.

asset.description: The asset's uuid, if the job needs one.

jobLead.description: The lead user's uuid. The lead joins the crew automatically.

tools.name: fieldaware_update_job
tools.title: Update job
tools.description: Change the schedule, description, duration, location, contact, asset or lead of one job. Only the fields you pass change. Tasks, items and labor are not changed by this tool. POST /job/{uuid}. Changes a real record.

job.description: The job uuid, as returned by a list or create tool.

location.description: An existing location, by its uuid.

prompts.name: getting_started

prompts.description: What you can do with FieldAware here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: plan_the_jobs_for_a_week
prompts.title: Plan the jobs for a week
prompts.description: List the jobs in a time window with their state and assigned lead. Open one job to see its crew, tasks and items.

prompts.name: find_a_customer_s_contacts_and_sites
prompts.title: Find a customer's contacts and sites
prompts.description: List the customers, then read their contact persons and service locations.

prompts.name: review_invoices_by_created_date
prompts.title: Review invoices by created date
prompts.description: List invoices with their number, location and total amount. Limit the list to a created-date range.

prompts.name: schedule_a_new_job_for_a_customer
prompts.title: Schedule a new job for a customer
prompts.description: Find the location and contact first. Then create the job with its date, time, location and job lead. Field staff will see the new job.

prompts.name: change_an_existing_job
prompts.title: Change an existing job
prompts.description: Change the schedule, description, duration, location, contact, asset or lead of one job. Tasks, items and labor stay as they are.
